reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant updates to the music system in Provincia! No more jarring transitions between day, night, title, and combat music. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a smoother experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Provincia: Music System Overhaul
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major improvement to the music system in Provincia! The transitions between day, night, title, and combat music are now smoother than ever thanks to our new equal-power crossfade technique. Read more about these changes and other updates on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
